description: This source file implements a test mode adapter for F1AP protocol messages, intercepting and injecting messages for testing purposes within a 5G network simulation or implementation. It defines classes and functions to handle F1AP message flow, particularly for test scenarios involving UE (User Equipment) and DU (Distributed Unit) interactions.

classes.name: f1ap_test_mode_adapter
classes.description: A class that wraps F1AP communication to intercept and inject test messages, implementing both f1ap_du and f1c_connection_client interfaces.

classes.name: f1ap_test_mode_adapter::f1ap_to_gw_pdu_interceptor
classes.description: Intercepts messages sent from F1AP-DU to the F1-C gateway, allowing message modification or inspection.

classes.name: f1ap_test_mode_adapter::gw_to_f1ap_pdu_interceptor
classes.description: Intercepts messages sent from the gateway to F1AP-DU, forwarding them appropriately.

methods.name: f1ap_test_mode_adapter::handle_du_connection_request
methods.description: Handles incoming DU connection requests, wrapping the notifier with interceptors for test message injection.

methods.name: ocudu::odu::create_du_high_f1ap
methods.description: Factory function to create a high-level F1AP DU, wrapping it with test mode adapter if test configuration is provided.
